- Olivia Chen (me) — Analytics PM
- Bob Carlson — Head of Analytics (procurement looped on procurement@orchiddata.com)

Best,

Quick answers / next steps:
- Im attaching our standard NDA (Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf) and a vendor onboarding link where you can upload the intake questionnaire and any security docs (SOC2 summary, pen test report, etc.).
- Were happy to run a 45-minute technical demo plus a short Q&A. Because Bob will be traveling during 6/22–6/26, we can tentatively pencil in the week of 6/29 for an exec-facing session.
- If youd like, Vanessa can do a short procurement/infosec drop-in the week of 6/22 to walk your team through the questionnaire and speed up the intake. That session can happen without Bob if procurement or security needs an early review.

Possible slots (all PT):
- Tue 23 Jun  Not available for execs per your note (kept as reference)
- Fri 26 Jun 11:00–11:30 — quick procurement/infosec review (Vanessa + Aditya)
- Tue 30 Jun 09:00–09:45 — technical + exec Q&A (Vanessa + Monica)
- Wed 30 Jun 14:00–14:45 — alternate

Can you confirm what procurement needs to see for the intake (full questionnaire vs. summary) and whether you can route the DocuSign link for the NDA back to us? Attaching Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf now.

Thanks,

Hi Monica — thanks for the quick response and for sharing the NDA. A couple of updates from procurement:

- They want the full vendor questionnaire completed (weve attached what we could fill out, but legal needs Redwood to complete the vendor intake fields that request environment details and data handling practices).
- We require a signed NDA via DocuSign from vendor legal before we schedule any exec-facing demos.
- Bob is traveling 6/226/26 and asked that the exec-level demo be moved to the week of 6/29. If you cant do the week of 6/29, please propose alternatives.

Im attaching our partially completed intake form (Orchid_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf). Procurement also requested a short SOC2 summary and any evidence of third-party pen test results if available.

If Vanessa can do a short walkthrough with procurement while Bob is traveling (to go over the questionnaire fields and expected artifacts), that would help speed things up. Would you be able to do a procurement-only touchpoint on Fri 6/26 at 11am PT?

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia / procurement team — appreciate the clarity. We can support both paths to keep momentum:

1) Procurement-only walkthrough: Vanessa can run a 30-minute intake walkthrough on Fri 26 Jun 11:00–11:30 PT to go line-by-line through the vendor questionnaire and clarify the artifacts that procurement will accept. That should help reduce back-and-forth on the form fields.

2) Exec-facing demo: well tentatively book Tue 30 Jun 09:00–09:45 PT for a technical + exec session (Vanessa + Monica). Please confirm if that week works for Bob — if not, we can shift to Wed 7 Jul.

3) NDA / DocuSign: We will upload the signed Redwood_NDA_v3 to DocuSign once you send the signing request to legal@redwood.com. Alternatively, we can sign and return a PDF if thats faster.

Attachments & next steps:
- Ive attached a calendar stub (calendar-invite.ics) for the 26 Jun procurement walkthrough; please accept if it works.
- Vanessa will bring our SOC2 summary + a one-page security note to the procurement meeting. If procurement can email any additional acceptance criteria prior to Fri, Vanessa can prep targeted items.
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/OD-2026-07 (Ill update stages once procurement confirms the walkthrough)

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Monica Patel
